`abstract class GlyphFont<F extends IFontFace>`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IFont`](/reference/text/ifont/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`BitmapFont`](/reference/text/bitmapfont/), [`MsdfFont`](/reference/text/msdffont/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.impl.glyph` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [GlyphFont.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/impl/glyph/GlyphFont.java)

Base class of the fonts made of glyphs, which hold a FontFamily of faces.

## Description

[`MsdfFont`](/reference/text/msdffont/) and [`BitmapFont`](/reference/text/bitmapfont/) extend it.
Extend it with your own [`IFontFace`](/reference/text/ifontface/) and [`GlyphTextRenderer`](/reference/text/glyphtextrenderer/) for another kind of glyph font; `getTextRenderer()` must return a renderer that draws this class.
